canberra-1.note: aph.gov.au/Visit_Parliament/Plan_your_Visit: free admission, 9-5 on non-sitting days and 8:30-6 on sitting days (public galleries after 6 pm while sitting), closed Christmas Day, airport-style security screening (allow 15 minutes); no photo-ID requirement is stated.

canberra-3.note: nga.gov.au/visit: free admission, open every day 10-5, sculpture garden sunrise to 9 pm; a 2026-2030 capital works program closes parts of the gallery and sculpture garden temporarily.

canberra-4.note: nma.gov.au/visit: free general admission, daily 9-5, closed Christmas Day.

canberra-9.note: page loads and is titled 'Visit - National Arboretum'; its opening-hours widget renders by script and shows no text: hours stay unverified.

canberra-17.note: nfsa.gov.au/plan-your-visit (the old /visit-us redirects): entry free, daily 10-4, closed Christmas Day and New Year's Day; the cinema and special events are ticketed.

canberra-31.note: tidbinbilla.act.gov.au/visit: day pass $16.09 per private vehicle (seniors/concession $9.66, motorcycle $6.01), reserve 7:30 am to 8 pm in daylight saving and to 6 pm otherwise, visitor centre 9-5 daily, closed Christmas Day and on total fire ban days.

canberra-34.note: page loads, titled 'Home - Stromlo Forest Park'; its opening hours render by script: hours and free entry stay on the Wikivoyage figures.

canberra-56.note: historicplaces.com.au/calthorpes-house: adult $12, concession $10, under 12 free; entry by guided tour only; the hours widget renders by script.

canberra-57.note: canberratracks.act.gov.au: church daily 9 am to 5 pm; schoolhouse museum Wed 10-12, Sat, Sun and public holidays 2-4.

canberra-65.note: access is by footpath through Callum Brae Nature Reserve (its car park starts the 8 km return, 3 hour Grassy Plains walk); access points are limited.

namadgi-national-park-1.note: Parks ACT walking tracks page: the 400 m return walk to the Gibraltar Falls lookout is CLOSED until further notice (2026-10-24); the falls are also seen from the road.

namadgi-national-park-2.note: Parks ACT walking tracks page: Booroomba Rocks is a Grade 4 walk, 2.5 km return from the Booroomba Rocks car park (about 1.5 hours).
